sql: SELECT 'P' k, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev, count(*)::text n, max(end_date)::text e, max(close_time)::text c, bool_or(disappeared_at IS NULL AND superseded_at IS NULL)::text live, max(disappeared_at)::text gone FROM incentive_programs WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPMENTION%-26OCT27-%' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B', at::text, residual_cents::text, coalesce(notes_json->>'residual_untrustworthy',''), '', '', '' FROM incentive_balance_observations WHERE at > now()-interval '40 hours' AND residual_cents IS NOT NULL AND residual_cents <> 0 ORDER BY 1,2
